about_the_game:
Divinate Waifu Racing is the midcore fantasy action RPG with elements of combat racing and gacha, has a non-linear story, where magically enhanced characters (the Sephiroths) run at speeds from 50 to 300 km/h, pick up and use weapons and abilities, knock down the enemies.

The strength of the characters is determined by horsepower, instead of the standard RPG-based strength, dexterity or intelligence.

In-battle controls are non-standard, just like in racing games - throttle, brake, drift, acceleration.

Terra Phantasma Base Management

The player's base is the hyperspace village named Terra Phantasma, where crafting, character training, mission planning, and storyline with romance progression take place.

Specialized islands and your account-wide passive skill tree let players craft their perfect economic strategy to dominate Elvynn's player-driven marketplace!

Squad Management

Build your dream team of 4 characters, with real-time switching available in certain game modes - adapt your tactics on the fly!

Trade characters and items with other players, creating endless possibilities for a thriving player-driven economy!

We fully support the DWR community's creativity through Steam Workshop and can't wait to showcase player creations in-game!

Elvynn Worldmap exploration

The world map serves as your strategic hub - move step-by-step between weekly events including:

• Dynamic battles

• Epic boss encounters

• Competitive tournaments

• Hidden treasures

• Wandering merchants

• Special random events

The endgame system lets you ramp up difficulty for greater challenges and better rewards from battles and bosses!

Action-Incidents

Choose from 14 distinct Incident types - whether you want pure racing, tactical sabotage, or brutal boss encounters!

Each Incident has strict entry requirements (like 300-350 horsepower limits or FWD only) to guarantee fair races where skill decides the winner!

Story rich

Key narrative genres: Adventure, Drama, and Romance.

The main characters are a group of outcasts called "Swagmen" who are trying to find a way to control the mysterious superpower Theokinesis and take one of the sides in a magical war.

Theokinesis allows its users to convert kinetic force into magical energy, granting unparalleled power that terrifies mages and politicians across the Elvynn.

Hunted yet determined, the Swagmen fight against the entire world to uncover the truth about Teokinesis, each other’s pasts, and the love that could either save Elvynn - or reduce it to ashes.

Every quest features at least two endings, and every boss can be defeated in multiple ways. The story campaign offers a minimum of three distinct conclusions.

What makes Divinate Waifu Racing special:

  • A mix of arcade racing, ARPG and Turn-Based Strategy genres;

  • A branching dramatic storyline based on the tabletop RPG universe Divinate (since 2002);

  • Dynamic races, arenas and boss fights;

  • A customizable passive skill tree for player's account;

  • Gacha mechanics with new items and characters;

  • The ability to bargain for better prices with NPCs;

  • A developing in-game market between players;

  • Hardcore endgame content;

  • Built-in Date-sim;

  • Unpredictable random events on the world map, affecting both the gameplay and the story;

  • Co-op modes;

  • Support for gamepad and even racing wheel;

  • Strict but stylish design;

  • High replayability;

  • Popular nowadays anime style.

  • Developers closely interact with the DWR community.

  • Potential for eSports.

content_descriptors.notes: Our game does NOT contain such content as non-consensual sex, BDSM, drug/alcohol abuse, and/or self-harm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K/AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050Ti/AMD Radeon R9 380X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible soundcard/Onboard chipset
  • Additional Notes: *"FPS (frame rate/second): Stable over 60" is guaranteed and selected under the graphic settings by default when the game is launched for the first time.*Frame rate may drop when other applications are running in the background.*Please note that minimum and recommended specifications are subjected to changes without notice.
